plan.summary:
Export `RetryPolicy` from the public entry points of both packages so library users can build their own retry policy.

- TypeScript: `src/index.ts` now also exports `RetryPolicy` and the `RetryOptions` type from `./retry`.
- Rust: `crates/core/src/lib.rs` now re-exports `retry::RetryPolicy` at the crate root.
plan.riskRationale: Two one-line re-exports. They add public API surface but change no logic. The retry module already exists.
plan.storyArc: The retry policy already exists in each package. This change makes it reachable from each package's public entry point. The TypeScript and Rust exports are reviewed together as one API change.

topics.title: Expose RetryPolicy in the public API of both packages
topics.narrativeBrief: What new public API do library users get? Check that the TypeScript export (`RetryPolicy`, `RetryOptions`) and the Rust re-export (`RetryPolicy`) name the same concept. Verify that the exported symbols exist in `./retry` and `retry`. The Rust re-export does not include an options type.
